name: The Polygon Proposal
source:
An 8-bit where you must convince a boardroom of 8-bit characters the concept of a 3d game before 3d ever existed.
This is a short visual novel where you must choose what happens to Gill by selecting from the options.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jamiegamedev.jamie.THE_POLYGON_PROPOSAL_V1_FINISHED&hl=de]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
这是一款8位风格作品：在3D尚未出现的时代，你必须说服一群8位角色接受3D游戏的理念。
这是一部短篇视觉小说，你需要从选项中做出选择，决定吉尔的命运。

[译自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jamiegamedev.jamie.THE_POLYGON_PROPOSAL_V1_FINISHED&hl=de]Google Play[/url]]
